observations.source_title: LMT Onsrud Hard Wood Cutting Data Recommendations (HP)
observations.source_page: Hard Wood sheet (HP), page 115, series 77-100, 1/8 in column: 0.003-0.005 in/tooth
observations.material_label: hard wood (Onsrud sheet); series 77-100 solid carbide taper tool
observations.ap_rule: cut depth per pass = cutting edge diameter (1xD); 2xD reduce chip load 25%; 3xD reduce chip load 50%
observations.notes: Printed row, transcribed 2026-09-23 from the stored text sources/onsrud_hard_wood_cutting_data.txt (feeds matrix R5, EVIDENCE 3.5-1 to 3.5-4, 4.1-14, 4.1-16). The sheet's 'cutting diameter' of a 77-100 taper tool is the ball tip diameter. flute_count 3 is the catalog flute count at this cutting diameter (77-102/104/106/108, 1/8 in CD: 3 flutes; 77-112/114/116, 1/4 in CD: 2 flutes); the chip load is per tooth. The sheet names no operation. The file holds one row per printed cell, filed under the home family pocket (pass_role roughing). The G3 family rule (feeds::extrapolation::family, ruling A3) serves the adaptive, contour, parallel, scallop and trace families from this row at x1.00. No row is copied into another family. The printed condition is 1 x D. hardness_value is the engine's own Janka proxy for this material family (GenericHardwood 1450, GenericSoftwood 600, MDF 1100, hardwood-faced plywood 1000, softwood plywood 600), so the printed band reaches the generic material unscaled; the sheet prints no hardness.
